name: Eli Lilly

logo.source: commons.wikimedia.org (File:Eli Lilly and Company.svg; Wikipedia infobox logo field empty)

description: Eli Lilly discovers, makes and sells prescription medicines and reports one segment. Since 2023 the business has become mainly two injectable drugs built on the same molecule, tirzepatide: Mounjaro for type 2 diabetes and Zepbound for obesity, which together were 56 percent of FY2025 revenue of $65.2 billion (up 45 percent). Money comes from selling patented drugs at list price less rebates and discounts, mostly through US pharmacy benefit managers and wholesalers; the US is 67 percent of revenue. Older franchises (Verzenio for breast cancer, Taltz and other immunology, Jardiance shared with Boehringer Ingelheim, Trulicity) are now a shrinking share. In Q2 2026 Lilly launched its first oral obesity drug, Foundayo (orforglipron), in the US.

gics.note: Conventional GICS label recorded from general knowledge of the standard scheme; not re-checked against an MSCI/S&P source. SEC SIC code is 2834 (Pharmaceutical Preparations), from the EDGAR submissions record.

hq.note: Lilly Corporate Center, Indianapolis, IN 46285 (FY2025 10-K cover)

employees.note: About 50,000 employees, about 27,000 outside the US; about 12,000 in R&D. FY2025 10-K

businessLines.name: Cardiometabolic health (diabetes, obesity)
businessLines.how: Patients (through insurers, employers, Medicare and cash-pay programs) pay for a weekly self-injected pen on a chronic repeat basis; revenue is price per prescription times prescriptions, less large rebates to pharmacy benefit managers. Growth is driven by prescription volume and, for obesity, insurance coverage and supply.
businessLines.description: Tirzepatide (Mounjaro, Zepbound), Trulicity, Jardiance and other diabetes and obesity products.

businessLines.name: Mounjaro (tirzepatide, type 2 diabetes)
businessLines.how: Weekly injection sold on prescription for type 2 diabetes; paid by insurers and government plans after rebates.

businessLines.name: Zepbound (tirzepatide, obesity)
businessLines.how: Weekly injection sold on prescription for chronic weight management; paid partly by insurers and partly by patients through discounted cash-pay channels, after rebates.

businessLines.name: Oncology
businessLines.how: Oral and injected cancer drugs sold per treatment course, paid by insurers and hospitals; revenue follows the number of patients on therapy and how long they stay on it.
businessLines.description: Verzenio (breast cancer) and other cancer medicines.

businessLines.name: Immunology
businessLines.how: Injected biologics for skin and gut inflammatory diseases, sold per prescription on chronic use and paid by insurers after rebates.

businessLines.name: Neuroscience
businessLines.how: Prescription neuroscience drugs sold per prescription or infusion and paid by insurers and Medicare.

revenue.note: US 997 + outside US 394; FY2024 was 1,474 total

businessLines.revenueNote: US 997 + outside US 394; FY2024 was 1,474 total

businessLines.name: Other
businessLines.how: Mature and legacy medicines sold per prescription.

brands.name: Trulicity
brands.share: 6.6% of FY2025 revenue ($4,276M), down from $5,254M in 2024

brands.name: Jardiance (with Boehringer Ingelheim)
